info.name: Faculty Exams — implemented API
info.description: Implemented public/identity endpoints and all 40 business CRUD methods. Obtain an administrator token through interactive Authorization Code + PKCE. Run the Business CRUD folder in order against a disposable demo database: create related fixtures, inspect/replace/list them, then clean up in reverse order. Writes invalidate publication. No credentials or tokens are exported.

exec: pm.test('Both services ready', () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.checks.database).to.eql('ok'); pm.expect(body.checks.identity).to.eql('ok'); });

pm.test('Valid page metadata', () => { pm.expect(page.data).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(page.page).to.be.above(0); pm.expect(page.page_size).to.be.within(1, 100); pm.expect(page.total).to.be.at.least(0); });

pm.test('Joined published exam data', () => page.data.forEach(exam => { pm.expect(exam).to.have.all.keys('id', 'course_id', 'course_code', 'course_name', 'term', 'department_id', 'department', 'session_id', 'date', 'start_time', 'end_time', 'rooms'); pm.expect(exam.rooms).to.be.an('array'); }));

item.name: Unknown API does not return the SPA

exec: pm.test('Structured API error', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().error.message).to.eql('API resource not found.'));

pm.test('Public client configuration', () => { const config = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(config.client_id).to.eql('exam-web'); pm.expect(config.issuer).to.include('/realms/'); pm.expect(config).not.to.have.property('client_secret'); });

pm.test('Verified identity and permissions', () => { const profile = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(profile.id).to.be.above(0); pm.expect(profile.role).to.be.oneOf(['member', 'administrator']); pm.expect(profile.permissions).to.be.an('array'); });

item.name: Reject submitted roles without verified identity

exec: pm.test('Bearer challenge instead of role login', () => pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('WWW-Authenticate')).to.include('Bearer'));

item.name: Business CRUD (administrator)
